reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I would like to warmly thank the entire team at this grooming salon for their professionalism and kindness.

We brought our dog, who had a lot of matting, in to have her hair trimmed. Unfortunately, due to the very matted state of her coat, a minor accident occurred during the grooming. At first glance, it didn't seem to require veterinary intervention.

Despite this, the manager immediately decided to take our dog to the vet herself as a precaution. She covered all the veterinary costs and also refused to charge us for the grooming service.

Beyond this gesture, she contacted us several times to check on our dog and make sure everything was alright. Such dedication is very rare these days.

I have nothing but praise for this salon. Their professionalism, honesty, and love for animals are exemplary. I recommend this salon without hesitation. A huge thank you again to the entire team for your dedication and compassion.
Excellent service, and very concerned about animal welfare. My goldendoodle Pisco loved his grooming sessions, where he was thoroughly pampered!

A complete scam!
First, I booked an appointment through the website, which was confirmed by email… but when I arrived, there was no space for us…
I came back the next day, clearly specifying over the phone that it was a Golden Retriever. The brochure stated "large long-haired dog" starting at €70, but specifically for Golden Retrievers—and I only learned this the hard way when I went to pay—it was €130 for a bath…!!
When I complained, they told me it was "starting from" and that Golden Retrievers are complicated… and that I should have asked for a quote!!!!
Why not mention it over the phone when they asked me the breed? It's still twice as expensive!!!

And nothing to compensate me for my canceled appointment the day before…
Furthermore, the young woman there was incredibly unpleasant; luckily, the other one was friendly. Avoid at all costs!
Total scam!
And please, don't tell me I'm one of those annoying customers. I worked in the clothing industry for 20 years; I know what a scam and customer service are... and when I leave a review, it's always positive. Except when I get ripped off, and thankfully that's rare...

I really liked the results; they far exceeded my expectations.

Simba
Jolly

My trusted place! I have such a great experience at Nina Dalle every time we go. I’ve been taking my 2kg long hair chihuahua since his very first baby nail trim as a puppy. He always looks beautiful and is calm and happy every time he goes (every 5 weeks).   He is a happy customer and that means the world to me. I never want the groomer to be scary or stressful for him. Here, he knows he’s among his friends and is always happy to come. Thanks to the team for being so kind to Georges and me!
Kindness and professionalism!! A thousand thanks for taking such good care of our dogs! I highly recommend them!
A first for my little Joy! A huge thank you to the team for their attentiveness and kindness. I highly recommend them for quick appointments. Thank you again!

Thank you so much.
I'm amazed.
The kindness, the service... incredibly high-quality work.

Very bad experience.

I brought my 8-month-old German Spitz in for a simple grooming, even though his fur wasn't matted. I was quoted a price based on time: €120 for up to two hours, €150 for more. I agreed.
In the end, the grooming was done in less than an hour, but I was still charged €150. For such a small dog, this is excessive and clearly feels like a rip-off.

Furthermore, the result was unsatisfactory: the area around his eyes was very red, there were still uncleaned streaks, and my dog ​​didn't seem well when he left. The service was quick, expensive, and lacked transparency. I will never go back and I recommend being very careful before going.

My little boy LOVED his time here!! When I came to pick him up, he strutted around extra cute and had so much energy. Nina and her team told me how he just melted into his bubbly bath. Next time we're hoping to catch it on camera. It was adorable! I picked up a harness as well as some wet food, which Nina was prompt to point out fresher cans. This team really enjoys their work and Im so sad I won't be able to indulge my boy after our vacation is done.
Highly reccomend the team at Nina Dalle! I’ve been taking my 8 Y.O golden doodle for a year - always leaves clean tidy happy. They take great care and do even better work. Thank you!
Thank you so much for your appréciation  🙏 …

There's a before and after. My Pomeranian, who is very timid, quickly gained confidence. A warm welcome, perfect grooming, and above all, a team that loves animals, is kind and dedicated. You leave with a wealth of valuable advice for your furry friend. Go there with your eyes wide open and enjoy the experience at Nina's. Thank you for everything, Nina and your team, and a big kiss to Caribou ;)

Our little dog is just 4 months old and had her first grooming session. We received a warm welcome from professionals attentive to the animal's well-being and the owners' expectations. We were very satisfied and happy to have found the groomer for our little Aria.

Delighted with this first experience for my dog ​​Lili! The professionals are attentive and patient, especially with Lili, who was very stressed, and so was I!
She came out looking beautiful!
I'll definitely go back :)
For the past few months, Ilda has been pampered and spoiled rotten, getting a thorough grooming at Nina Dalle's. Don't hesitate. Go ahead, you won't be disappointed. You'll be delighted!
